bloques.titulo: In this context, the Commission will be able to take the necessary steps to ensure that the Commission is able to take the necessary measures to ensure that it is able to achieve the objectives of the programme.
texto: To say that something will be done immediately after another action: root of the form h- and **しだい**: **つき しだい、 れんらく します** (as soon as it comes, I will warn you).
It is formal and frequent in notices and work communications.
To say that something depends on something else: noun + **しだい で**: **てんき しだい で、 しゅっぱつ を きめます** (depending on the time, I will decide when to leave).
It's a way to leave something open.
